excerpts.author: rahulbarmann
excerpts.content:
Hey everyone, here's my week 8 update! I was working on wiring the IL store into BeaconChain and added the inclusion_list gossip topic on top, both as a two-layer stack in my fork. Also raised and merged a small spec sync PR renaming inclusion_list_committee_root to dependent_root, and addressed Eitan's review notes on the committee derivation and store PRs. This week I'm getting those two merged and then raising the stack upstream.

https://hackmd.io/@rahulbarman/ryWttluLzl
